summary:
Astro Care – Astronaut Health Monitoring System

Astro Care is a browser-based astronaut health monitoring dashboard designed to support astronauts' physical and mental well-being during space missions. Our project provides a unified platform to monitor important health parameters such as heart rate, blood pressure, oxygen levels (SpO₂), blood sugar, body temperature, hydration, sleep, stress, activity, and radiation exposure.

The dashboard includes interactive health indicators, alerts, health trend tracking, mission environments (Earth, ISS, Moon, Mars, and Deep Space), mental wellness check-ins, daily mission routines, and health report exports. It helps astronauts and mission teams understand health information, identify readings that may need attention, and maintain regular wellness records.

Astro Care addresses the challenges of monitoring astronaut health in different space environments, where limited medical facilities and long-duration missions make continuous health awareness important.
Our goal is to create a smarter, more accessible health-monitoring experience that can contribute to safer, healthier, and more sustainable future space exploration.
details:
Project Details – Astro Care

1. Project Overview

Astro Care is a smart, browser-based Astronaut Health Monitoring System designed to support astronauts' physical and mental health during space missions. It provides a unified digital dashboard where important health parameters, wellness activities, alerts, and medical records can be monitored and managed.

2. How Does It Work?

The system provides an interactive dashboard with multiple modules:

- Health Monitoring: Displays heart rate, blood pressure, oxygen saturation (SpO₂), blood sugar, body temperature, hydration, sleep, stress, physical activity, and radiation exposure.

- Health Alerts: Classifies health readings into Normal, Watch, and Alert categories to help identify parameters that may need attention.

- Mission Environments: Supports different mission contexts, including Earth, ISS, Moon, Mars, and Deep Space.

- Health Trends: Allows users to enter readings, save checkups, and review health trends through charts.

- Mental Wellness: Includes mood check-ins and workload monitoring.

- Mission Routine: Provides daily wellness tasks, progress tracking, XP points, and achievement badges.

- Reports: Supports exporting health records in TXT and CSV formats, along with printing and PDF options.

3. Technologies and Tools Used

Our project uses web technologies to create an interactive and responsive dashboard:

- HTML5 – Structure of the website.

- CSS3 – Professional interface, styling, animations, and responsive design.

- JavaScript – Interactive features, health calculations, simulated readings, alerts, and dashboard functionality.

- Browser LocalStorage – Stores checkups, alerts, mood records, and routine progress locally.

- Visual Charts and UI Components – Display health trends and monitoring information.

4. Benefits and Intended Impact

Astro Care aims to make astronaut health information easier to understand and manage. It brings physical health monitoring, mental wellness, mission routines, and health records together in one platform. It can help astronauts maintain wellness awareness and help mission teams review recorded health information.

5. Creativity and Innovation

The innovative aspect of Astro Care is its combination of astronaut health monitoring, mission-specific environments, interactive body-system visualization, mental wellness tracking, and gamified daily routines in a single dashboard. Its interface is designed around the unique challenges of space exploration, including microgravity and long-duration missions.

6. Future Scope

Future development may include integration with wearable health sensors, secure astronaut and medical-team access, scientifically validated medical thresholds, AI-assisted health trend analysis, and communication between astronauts and ground-based medical teams.

Our Vision: To contribute to safer, smarter, and healthier human space exploration through digital health technology.
